new: A new story on the Experiments cards: The switch that sticks, by Christiane Hütter. It follows CDK5, a switch in neurons, among 16,376 human proteins, from healthy signalling to Alzheimer's disease and a landscape of diseases.
It is narrated (8:27) and has its own explore mode: the six scenes, any protein by name, 88 disease terms and an About tab.
Two new miniatures for it: its station icon, a map of proteins, and CDK5 at the centre. Both stand on the design room's table.
test: In a headset, open Experiments and play The switch that sticks. In the first two chapters the map should stand round you; from the third it floats in front of you.
Check the map never comes closer than an arm's length to your eyes, also after zooming in explore mode.
In explore mode, point at a protein and pull the trigger; try Stand inside on the map of processes, then Whole scene.
On a phone and a laptop, play it through once and try each explore tab.
In a shared room, add it as a circle and check two people see the same scene, protein and disease term.
untested: Anything of the new story in a real headset: placement, standing inside, the trigger and the panels.
How its narration and sound effects sound.
Its frame rate on a Quest with 16,376 points.
